label: Classical conditioning; Rescorla–Wagner
text: MS.O.A1.3.1 Classical conditioning: a cue comes to predict an outcome. Rescorla–Wagner model: on each trial, ΔV = αβ(λ − ΣV), where α and β are cue and outcome salience rates in (0,1], λ is the outcome's maximum, and ΣV sums all cues present.

warrant.standard: Effect replicates across paradigms with stated range
